candidates.title: Cross-link GOVERNANCE + COGNITION
candidates.hypothesis: Combining observations from GOVERNANCE and COGNITION may expose a capability neither reveals alone.
candidates.experiment: Run both observation paths on the same synthetic scenario and compare signal coverage.
success_criteria: no new unsupported claim is introduced

candidates.title: Transfer verification pattern: GOVERNANCE -> LEARNING
candidates.hypothesis: A verification pattern from GOVERNANCE may improve evidence quality in LEARNING.
candidates.experiment: Apply the same synthetic verification fixture to both components and compare evidence completeness.
success_criteria: source and destination semantics remain distinct

candidates.title: Extend evidence path for GOVERNANCE
candidates.hypothesis: Adding a verification step to GOVERNANCE may convert an architectural assumption into evidence.
candidates.experiment: Attach one measurable verification probe and run it against a controlled fixture.

candidates.title: Reverse assumption around GOVERNANCE
candidates.hypothesis: Testing the opposite of the current assumption for GOVERNANCE may reveal a hidden boundary condition.
candidates.experiment: Run the same fixture with the target assumption inverted and compare outcomes.

candidates.title: Reorder GOVERNANCE -> COGNITION -> EXECUTION
candidates.hypothesis: Changing component order may reduce unnecessary work or expose an earlier detection point.
candidates.experiment: Execute two equivalent synthetic pipelines with the order swapped; compare latency and evidence.
success_criteria: measured cost changes or remains stable

candidates.title: Ablation of COGNITION
candidates.hypothesis: Temporarily remove COGNITION in a sandbox to determine whether it contributes unique value.
candidates.experiment: Run baseline and ablated synthetic pipelines; compare correctness and evidence coverage.

candidates.title: Turn a failed experiment into a boundary test
candidates.hypothesis: A failed or inconclusive experiment may encode a useful constraint rather than useless noise.
candidates.experiment: Reproduce the failure with one controlled variable changed at a time.

candidates.title: Generate a cross-layer probe
candidates.hypothesis: A signal observed in one layer may become informative when tested against another layer's evidence.
candidates.experiment: Select one observable from two layers, correlate them only inside a synthetic fixture, and test whether the relation survives a changed fixture.
success_criteria: relation is reproducible or explicitly rejected
no causal claim is inferred from correlation

truth_boundary: synthetic fixture outcomes are not proof of production performance
architecture contract evidence_refs are not inferred from code presence
failure and inconclusive results remain visible
hard_boundary: promotion requires explicit verification and approval
